description: Create a card top-up for a whole-dollar balance (it pays bounties and part calls) from $10 to $10,000: url is the Stripe Checkout, pay_url a short page to show a person (it stays valid for 72 hours and starts a new checkout when one expires), pay_status_url reads whether it is paid. After it is paid the key pays bounties and part calls from this balance on its own.
name: balance_topup_link
title: Create a balance top-up link
